LESSON: TIME

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement 2.3 Capacity By the end of the sub-strand, the  Learners in pairs/g
Topic 2.4: Time

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Time. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-097.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 97]]

From your pupil's book (page 97)

Week 10 Lesson 1 Time by the hour Activity 1 : Read and tell time

The time is The time is The time is The time is 3 o’clock 8 o’clock 6 o’clock 12 o’clock

Work to do 1. What is the time? a) b) c) d)

___o’clock ___o’clock ___o’clock ___o’clock

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-098.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 98]]

From your pupil's book (page 98)

Week 10 Lesson 2 Time past the hour Example

Quarter past 12 o’clock 15 minutes past 12 o’clock

Half past 2 o’clock. 30 minutes past 2 o’clock

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-187.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 187]]

From your pupil's book (page 187)

Time Week 10 Lesson 2 Reading and telling time “to” the hour

Quarter to 20 minutes 12 o’clock to 10 o’clock

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Time means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Time.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Time
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
